Metadata.title: Supplify
Metadata.description: An online marketplace between suppliers and retailers

Home.title: Supplify
Home.subtitle: Connect suppliers and retailers with orders, invoices, payments, and stock on one platform.

Admin.dashboardSubtitle: Operational overview with pipelines and recent activity. Use the menu on mobile to reach every admin section.
Admin.heroTitle: Operate the marketplace from one place
Admin.heroSubtitle: Responsive dashboard with live counts, order and invoice pipelines, audit highlights, and shortcuts.
Admin.ordersPipelineHint: Each segment is a share of all orders. Hover a color for the count.
Admin.tileFxDesc: Global price currency and live FX sync
Admin.usersSubtitle: Search by email, name, business, or phone. Assign supplier, retailer, or admin roles—changes apply across the platform.
Admin.cannotDemoteSelf: You cannot remove your own administrator role here.
Admin.suppliersSubtitle: Filter by business, contact, or email. Read-only directory of supplier storefronts.
Admin.retailersSubtitle: Filter retailer accounts by business, contact, email, or city.
Admin.currenciesSubtitle: The single global price basis: reporting currency and multipliers for ILS, USD, and JOD. Catalog prices stay in each supplier’s currency; reporting converts here. Sync live market rates or fine-tune manually.
Admin.defaultCurrencyHint: Must be ILS, USD, or JOD — aligned with catalogs and invoices.
Admin.fxRatesHint: 1 unit of currency × multiplier = value in the global price currency. Sync pulls public market feeds; overrides are always possible.
Admin.marketRatesIntro: Fetches mid-market quotes (open.er-api first, Frankfurter ECB as fallback) and writes multipliers for all supported currencies. Run after changing global price currency if needed.
Admin.marketRatesAutoSync: Automated sync also runs once daily at 06:00 UTC when deployment cron is configured (same endpoint as other scheduled jobs; uses CRON_SECRET).
Admin.referenceSubtitle: Values stored in the database. Changing enums requires a migration and deploy.
Admin.auditSubtitle: Filter by event type. Read-only trail of important platform actions.
